# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.1.1

- Logo: replaced with the official Google Docs product icon (Google productlogos `docs_2020q4`) on a white rounded tile with transparent corners, so clients show it as a whole mark instead of a cropped page.

## 1.1.0

- Refreshed the `google-docs` skill for the latest tool surface.

## 1.0.0 - initial release

- Logo: official Google Docs product icon on a padded white tile.
- Added the `google-docs` MCP server pointing at `https://api.cursor.com/rest-mcp/google-docs/mcp`.
- Bundled the `google-docs` skill covering the index contract, styling, lists, tables, and images.
